en.text: In the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, Rezin the king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up to Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.

zhSimplified.text: 乌西雅的孙子、约坦的儿子、犹大王亚哈斯在位的时候，亚兰王利汛和利玛利的儿子、以色列王比加上来攻打耶路撒冷，却不能攻取。

zhTraditional.text: 烏西雅的孫子、約坦的兒子、猶大王亞哈斯在位的時候，亞蘭王利汛和利瑪利的兒子、以色列王比加上來攻打耶路撒冷，卻不能攻取。

en.text: David’s house was told, “Syria is allied with Ephraim.” His heart trembled, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the forest tremble with the wind.

zhSimplified.text: 有人告诉大卫家说：「亚兰与以法莲已经同盟。」王的心和百姓的心就都跳动，好像林中的树被风吹动一样。

zhTraditional.text: 有人告訴大衛家說：「亞蘭與以法蓮已經同盟。」王的心和百姓的心就都跳動，好像林中的樹被風吹動一樣。

en.text: Then the LORD said to Isaiah, “Go out now to meet Ahaz, you, and Shearjashub your son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool, on the highway of the fuller’s field.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华对以赛亚说：「你和你的儿子施亚雅述出去，到上池的水沟头，在漂布地的大路上，去迎接亚哈斯，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華對以賽亞說：「你和你的兒子施亞雅述出去，到上池的水溝頭，在漂布地的大路上，去迎接亞哈斯，

en.text: Tell him, ‘Be careful, and keep calm. Don’t be afraid, neither let your heart be faint because of these two tails of smoking torches, for the fierce anger of Rezin and Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.

zhSimplified.text: 对他说：『你要谨慎安静，不要因亚兰王利汛和利玛利的儿子这两个冒烟的火把头所发的烈怒害怕，也不要心里胆怯。

zhTraditional.text: 對他說：『你要謹慎安靜，不要因亞蘭王利汛和利瑪利的兒子這兩個冒煙的火把頭所發的烈怒害怕，也不要心裏膽怯。

en.text: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have plotted evil against you, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 因为亚兰和以法莲，并利玛利的儿子，设恶谋害你，

zhTraditional.text: 因為亞蘭和以法蓮，並利瑪利的兒子，設惡謀害你，

en.text: “Let’s go up against Judah, and tear it apart, and let’s divide it among ourselves, and set up a king within it, even the son of Tabeel.”

zhSimplified.text: 说：我们可以上去攻击犹大，扰乱它，攻破它，在其中立他比勒的儿子为王。

zhTraditional.text: 說：我們可以上去攻擊猶大，擾亂它，攻破它，在其中立他比勒的兒子為王。

en.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: “It shall not stand, neither shall it happen.”

zhSimplified.text: 所以主耶和华如此说： 这所谋的必立不住， 也不得成就。

zhTraditional.text: 所以主耶和華如此說： 這所謀的必立不住， 也不得成就。

en.text: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin. Within sixty-five years Ephraim shall be broken in pieces, so that it shall not be a people.

zhSimplified.text: 原来亚兰的首城是大马士革； 大马士革的首领是利汛。 以法莲必然破坏，不再成为国民。）

zhTraditional.text: 原來亞蘭的首城是大馬士革； 大馬士革的首領是利汛。 以法蓮必然破壞，不再成為國民。）

en.text: The head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah’s son. If you will not believe, surely you shall not be established.’”

zhSimplified.text: 以法莲的首城是撒马利亚； 撒马利亚的首领是利玛利的儿子。 你们若是不信， 定然不得立稳。』」

zhTraditional.text: 以法蓮的首城是撒馬利亞； 撒馬利亞的首領是利瑪利的兒子。 你們若是不信， 定然不得立穩。』」

en.text: The LORD spoke again to Ahaz, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华又晓谕亚哈斯说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華又曉諭亞哈斯說：

en.text: “Ask a sign of the LORD your God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.”

zhSimplified.text: 「你向耶和华—你的 神求一个兆头：或求显在深处，或求显在高处。」

zhTraditional.text: 「你向耶和華－你的上帝求一個兆頭：或求顯在深處，或求顯在高處。」

en.text: But Ahaz said, “I won’t ask. I won’t tempt the LORD.”

zhSimplified.text: 亚哈斯说：「我不求；我不试探耶和华。」

zhTraditional.text: 亞哈斯說：「我不求；我不試探耶和華。」

en.text: He said, “Listen now, house of David. Is it not enough for you to try the patience of men, that you will try the patience of my God also?

zhSimplified.text: 以赛亚说：「大卫家啊，你们当听！你们使人厌烦岂算小事，还要使我的 神厌烦吗？

zhTraditional.text: 以賽亞說：「大衛家啊，你們當聽！你們使人厭煩豈算小事，還要使我的上帝厭煩嗎？

en.text: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign. Behold, the virgin will conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.

zhSimplified.text: 因此，主自己要给你们一个兆头，必有童女怀孕生子，给他起名叫以马内利。

footnotes.text: - 7:14 就是 神与我们同在的意思

zhTraditional.text: 因此，主自己要給你們一個兆頭，必有童女懷孕生子，給他起名叫以馬內利。

footnotes.text: - 7:14 就是上帝與我們同在的意思

en.text: He shall eat butter and honey when he knows to refuse the evil and choose the good.

zhSimplified.text: 到他晓得弃恶择善的时候，他必吃奶油与蜂蜜。

zhTraditional.text: 到他曉得棄惡擇善的時候，他必吃奶油與蜂蜜。

en.text: For before the child knows to refuse the evil and choose the good, the land whose two kings you abhor shall be forsaken.

zhSimplified.text: 因为在这孩子还不晓得弃恶择善之先，你所憎恶的那二王之地必致见弃。

zhTraditional.text: 因為在這孩子還不曉得棄惡擇善之先，你所憎惡的那二王之地必致見棄。

en.text: The LORD will bring on you, on your people, and on your father’s house days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah, even the king of Assyria.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华必使亚述王攻击你的日子临到你和你的百姓，并你的父家，自从以法莲离开犹大以来，未曾有这样的日子。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華必使亞述王攻擊你的日子臨到你和你的百姓，並你的父家，自從以法蓮離開猶大以來，未曾有這樣的日子。

en.text: It will happen in that day that the LORD will whistle for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.

zhSimplified.text: 「那时，耶和华要发嘶声，使埃及江河源头的苍蝇和亚述地的蜂子飞来；

zhTraditional.text: 「那時，耶和華要發嘶聲，使埃及江河源頭的蒼蠅和亞述地的蜂子飛來；

en.text: They shall come, and shall all rest in the desolate valleys, in the clefts of the rocks, on all thorn hedges, and on all pastures.

zhSimplified.text: 都必飞来，落在荒凉的谷内、磐石的穴里，和一切荆棘篱笆中，并一切的草场上。

zhTraditional.text: 都必飛來，落在荒涼的谷內、磐石的穴裏，和一切荊棘籬笆中，並一切的草場上。

en.text: In that day the Lord will shave with a razor that is hired in the parts beyond the River, even with the king of Assyria, the head and the hair of the feet; and it shall also consume the beard.

zhSimplified.text: 「那时，主必用大河外赁的剃头刀，就是亚述王，剃去头发和脚上的毛，并要剃净胡须。

zhTraditional.text: 「那時，主必用大河外賃的剃頭刀，就是亞述王，剃去頭髮和腳上的毛，並要剃淨鬍鬚。

en.text: It shall happen in that day that a man shall keep alive a young cow, and two sheep.

zhSimplified.text: 「那时，一个人要养活一只母牛犊，两只母绵羊；

zhTraditional.text: 「那時，一個人要養活一隻母牛犢，兩隻母綿羊；

en.text: It shall happen, that because of the abundance of milk which they shall give he shall eat butter, for everyone will eat butter and honey that is left within the land.

zhSimplified.text: 因为出的奶多，他就得吃奶油，在境内所剩的人都要吃奶油与蜂蜜。

zhTraditional.text: 因為出的奶多，他就得吃奶油，在境內所剩的人都要吃奶油與蜂蜜。

en.text: It will happen in that day that every place where there were a thousand vines worth a thousand silver shekels, will be for briers and thorns.

footnotes.text: 7:23 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces, so 1000 shekels is about 10 kilograms or 22 pounds.

zhSimplified.text: 「从前，凡种一千棵葡萄树、值银一千舍客勒的地方，到那时必长荆棘和蒺藜。

zhTraditional.text: 「從前，凡種一千棵葡萄樹、值銀一千舍客勒的地方，到那時必長荊棘和蒺藜。

en.text: People will go there with arrows and with bow, because all the land will be briers and thorns.

zhSimplified.text: 人上那里去，必带弓箭，因为遍地满了荆棘和蒺藜。

zhTraditional.text: 人上那裏去，必帶弓箭，因為遍地滿了荊棘和蒺藜。

en.text: All the hills that were cultivated with the hoe, you shall not come there for fear of briers and thorns; but it shall be for the sending out of oxen, and for sheep to tread on.”

zhSimplified.text: 所有用锄刨挖的山地，你因怕荆棘和蒺藜，不敢上那里去；只可成了放牛之处，为羊践踏之地。」

zhTraditional.text: 所有用鋤刨挖的山地，你因怕荊棘和蒺藜，不敢上那裏去；只可成了放牛之處，為羊踐踏之地。」
